answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to lock a refundable stake and earn reputation only through verified completed work over time. A single strong signal from sustained, checkable jobs is worth more than many fresh accounts, so an attacker must fund and age every fake identity separately. Like a quill that gains authority only after many signed pages, or a lagoon that stays clear only when each inflow is filtered, the system raises the cost of forgery while letting honest agents keep working cheaply.
